subject: SDR tools brokerage: SOW, security evidence & marketplace credit options
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Matthews <kyle@outreach.io>, Anne Park <anne@hubspot.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SDR tools brokerage: SOW, security evidence & marketplace credit options

Kyle / Anne —

Quick summary: Sales Ops has been asked to put together a recommended procurement path for the SDR tooling stack for H1 2027. We are evaluating a hybrid approach (Outreach for sequences + HubSpot for CRM/workflows) and want to formalize a short SOW for a consulting partner to help with migration, seat mapping and data continuity.

Immediate asks:
- Can you share a vendor SOW template you typically use for a 3–6 week onboarding + migration engagement?
- Security evidence: SOC2 scope, data residency details, and any recent pen-test/attestation artifacts you can provide.
- Marketplace/partner credits: do you offer cloud marketplace credits or co-op implementation credits for customers who sign a 12–24 month commitment?

I've attached our current license inventory to help size the ask. CC'ing Ben and Marissa for commercial/contract alignment.

Timeline: We'd like draft SOWs and pricing proposals by EOD Thurs (2026-11-05) so Procurement can build a single PO and estimate TCO.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: current-license-inventory.csv (csv)
From: Kyle Matthews <kyle@outreach.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, SOW Consulting Co <sow@consultingco.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SDR tools brokerage: SOW, security evidence & marketplace credit options

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the concise brief. Attaching a draft Outreach SOW and our security matrix that maps our SOC2 controls and recent pentest summary. Highlights below:
- Outreach_SOW_v1.pdf: 4-week standard migration + 2-week sequence tuning and admin training; optional add-on for migration analytics.
- Outreach_Security_Matrix.xlsx: SOC2 Type II (report available under NDA), data separation model, and redaction options for PII in exports.
- Marketplace: Outreach currently runs a co-funding program via marketplace partners — typical contribution is 10–15% implementation credit on 12+ month commitments, with larger credits on multi-year deals. We can provisionally reserve a $25k credit if Redwood moves forward by 2026-12-15.

Trial metrics we can provide to help the SOW: historical deliverables and estimated seat migration throughput (we can move ~200 accounts/week with our migration team). If you want, we can set a short workshop next week to align scope with SOW Consulting Co (cc).

Best,
Kyle Matthews
Strategic Accounts, Outreach

Attachments: Outreach_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf); Outreach_Security_Matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Anne Park <anne@hubspot.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SDR tools brokerage: SOW, security evidence & marketplace credit options

Hi all —

Appreciate the context. I've attached our pricing proposal and a short note on integration patterns with Outreach (we've done this for several enterprise customers). Quick notes:
- HubSpot_Pricing_Proposal.pdf: includes full CRM seat tiers, Marketing Hub tie-ins, and professional services options.
- Credits: HubSpot offers marketplace credits via select partners; amount depends on region and commitment. We can explore a partner-funded credit if Redwood signs a 12-month upfront contract.
- Security: we can provide SOC2 attestation under an NDA and have a standard security questionnaire response bundle.

I'm looping in SOW Consulting Co (sow@consultingco.com) — they do a good job on pricing harmonization and data-mapping between tools. If you'd like, we can run a joint 60-minute scoping call next Tue (2026-11-10).

Regards,
Anne Park
Enterprise Sales, HubSpot

Attachment: HubSpot_Pricing_Proposal.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SDR tools brokerage: SOW, security evidence & marketplace credit options

Team —

Thanks for the vendor responses. Short internal write-up for Procurement & Security:

1) Commercial ask: target a 12–24 month combined contract that preserves HubSpot CRM seats and outsources sequence orchestration to Outreach. We should negotiate marketplace credit holdbacks from both vendors and centralize implementation within SOW Consulting Co to limit vendor churn.

2) Security: Connor — can you validate Outreach_Security_Matrix.xlsx and confirm whether the SOC2 evidence and pen-test summary satisfy our baseline? If not, list gaps and we'll request the SOC2 report under NDA.

3) Next steps & deliverables (procurement ticket PR-4821):
   - Solicit final SOWs (Outreach + HubSpot + SOW Consulting Co) by 2026-11-12.
   - Procurement to build one consolidated PO with line items for software + implementation credits.
   - Legal to confirm standard SLAs and data retention clauses.

I've attached a quick comparison spreadsheet I made from the vendor materials and our inventory. Please review and flag any missing commercial items before we move to PO.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sdr_tools_comparison_20261108.csv (csv)
